research_question: Does one fixed calendar-month-conditioned Beta-smoothed inclusion-frequency ranking improve a three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null on targets 401..1250, using only earlier draws from the target's calendar month?
novelty_statement: One exogenous calendar-month conditioning feature. Prior axes use number history, lagged draw states, bonus distance, gap shape, overlap, or score calibration; this axis uses only the target draw's known calendar month to condition a single historical inclusion-frequency estimator. One fixed Beta(6,39) prior, one deterministic top-18 partition, one walk-forward, no variants or parameter search. Historical screening only; not an independent sample or prospective confirmation.

feature_definition.conditioning: calendar month of target draw date
feature_definition.availability: target draw calendar month is known before the draw
feature_definition.history: only draws with round < target_round and calendar month equal to target_month
feature_definition.exposure: one exposure per prior same-month draw
feature_definition.success: candidate number appears among the six main numbers; bonus excluded
feature_definition.future_data: no target or later draw numbers enter the estimator

estimator.ranking: posterior probability descending, then number ascending

random_comparator.method: uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving line sizes, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry

inference.ci_method: two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if historical gates pass, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: This historical screen cannot create STRICT_PASS_READY. Any historical gate pass remains prospective-confirmation-pending.
